# Solar Pro 4

> Source: /docs/models/solar-pro-4

Upstage's flagship model, specialized for agentic use

[Compare](/docs/models/compare/generative-intelligence)

Contributor version at 70% off the list price

`solar-pro-4-contributor` is the same model at 70% off the list price, and Upstage stores its requests and responses. An organization owner must turn on Contributor models on the Model access page in the console before you can call it. [Go to Model access](/model-access) · [Learn more about contributor mode](/docs/guides/contributor-mode)

- **Intelligence**: 5 (Higher)
- **Speed**: 4 (Fast)
- **Price**: $0.15/1M tokens (Input Token)
- **Price**: $0.60/1M tokens (Output Token)
- **Price**: $0.03/1M tokens (Cached Token)

Solar Pro 4 is Upstage's flagship model, specialized for agentic use. It is particularly strong at document-based work, coding, and business-related tasks, and substantially improves agent performance compared to Solar Pro 3. It supports a 512K context length with full English, Korean, and Japanese coverage.

- 512K context length
- Undisclosed parameters
- Feb, 2026 training data cut-off
- Reasoning mode available

## Languages

- English: Input and output
- Korean: Input and output
- Japanese: Input and output

## Capabilities

- [Chat](/docs/capabilities/generate/chat): Supported
- [Structured outputs](/docs/capabilities/generate/structured-outputs): Supported
- [Tool calling](/docs/capabilities/generate/tool-calling): Supported
- [Reasoning](/docs/capabilities/generate/reasoning): Supported

## Max output tokens

128K

## List price

$0.30 input / $1.20 output / $0.06 cached per 1M tokens. A promotional discount is currently applied.

## Contributor mode

`solar-pro-4-contributor` runs the same model at 70% off the list price, in exchange for using your prompts and responses to train Solar. The Owner of your Organization needs to opt in before you can use it.

$0.09 / 1M input tokens · $0.018 / 1M cached input tokens · $0.36 / 1M output tokens

[Learn more about contributor mode](/docs/guides/contributor-mode)

## Available Platforms

- Upstage Console
- [Playground](/playground/chat)
- [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/upstage/solar-pro4)
- [On-premises](https://www.upstage.ai/contact-us?utm_medium=console&utm_source=docs-models&utm_content=text-link)

Released on 2026-08-06

Training data cut-off: Feb, 2026

Solar Pro 4 is Upstage's flagship model, specialized for agentic use.

- Substantially improved agent performance compared to Solar Pro 3
- Particularly strong at document-based work, coding, and business-related tasks
- 512K context length and up to 128K output tokens
- Full English, Korean, and Japanese support
- Supports chat, reasoning, structured outputs, and tool calling

### solar-pro-4-260806-contributor (Alias: solar-pro-4-contributor) (Contributor)

Released on 2026-11-23

Price per 1M tokens: Input $0.09 · Output $0.36 · Cached $0.018

Training data cut-off: Feb, 2026

The contributor mode version of Solar Pro 4. It runs the same model as `solar-pro-4-260806` at 70% off the list price. Upstage stores requests and responses to this version. An organization owner must turn on Contributor models in the console before you can call it. [Learn more](/docs/guides/contributor-mode)

- Available platforms: Upstage Console, OpenRouter (from November 25, 2026, 00:00 UTC)
